outcomes.name: list prints every order
outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 1: "`orders list` prints one line per order in the id order above, each showing id, customer, item and total, in that order, with the total to two decimals (the first line carries 1001, Alice Nguyen, Standing desk, 480.00)." Criterion 7: "The successful runs above exit with status 0."

outcomes.name: total sums every order
outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 2: "`orders total` prints one line, `Total: 880.00`." Criterion 7: "The successful runs above exit with status 0."

outcomes.name: search limits list to one customer
outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 3: "`--search NAME` limits either command to orders whose customer name contains NAME, ignoring case and surrounding spaces. `orders list --search alice` prints the two Alice Nguyen lines; `orders total --search ALICE` prints `Total: 515.00`." Proved here: the list example.

outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 4: "Search looks at customer names only: `orders list --search desk` finds nothing." Proved here for the item, id and total columns, on list and on total.

outcomes.expect: Ticket criterion 5: "When nothing matches, `list` prints `No orders match NAME` (for example `No orders match zed`) and `total` prints `Total: 0.00`." Proved here: list. Criterion 7: "The successful runs above exit with status 0."

outcomes.name: total is zero when nothing matches
